_comment: Paths this project excludes from UI-surface discovery, each with a reason. Universal shapes (build output, dependencies, reports, vendored assets) live in scripts/lib/design-contract/surfaces.mjs; only project-specific decisions belong here. An entry without a reason is rejected.

exclusions.why: Remotion renders per frame and its evidence is a real render, not a stylesheet scan; the motion contract defers to that.
